name: Long Slow Distance — Base Builder
objective: Build aerobic foundation, mitochondrial density, capillary network. Develop ability to sustain low-intensity effort for extended duration.
work_description: Continuous running at conversational pace (able to speak in full sentences)
progression: Add 2-5 min per week. Max 60 min. Or increase distance by 500m every 2 weeks.
regression: Reduce to walk intervals (5 min jog, 2 min walk). Decrease duration by 50%.

name: Long Slow Distance — Aerobic Volume
objective: Increase aerobic capacity and endurance base. Higher volume than base builder.
work_description: Continuous running at 60-70% HRmax. RPE 3-4.
progression: Add 5 min or 1 km every 2 weeks. Increase pace by 5-10s per km every 4 weeks while maintaining HR zone.
regression: Reduce to 20 min. Alternate with 5 min walk breaks.

name: Recovery Jog
objective: Active recovery. Increase blood flow, reduce muscle soreness, maintain movement quality.
work_description: Very light jogging at 50-60% HRmax. RPE 2-3. Shoes optional (barefoot on grass preferred).
progression: N/A — this is recovery, not progression. Maintain intensity ceiling.
regression: Walk instead of jog. 10 min.

name: Cross-Training Aerobic
objective: Build aerobic base while reducing impact on joints. Alternative for high-impact athletes or during injury management.
work_description: Continuous effort at 60-70% HRmax. RPE 3-4. Bike, elliptical, rower, or swim.
progression: Add 5 min every 2 weeks. Increase resistance/RPM while maintaining HR zone.
regression: Reduce duration to 15 min. Reduce intensity to RPE 2.

name: Aerobic Walk-Jog Progression
objective: Transition from walking to continuous jogging. Beginner aerobic building.
work_description: 3 min jog, 2 min walk. Repeat.
progression: Increase jog time (4 min jog, 1 min walk). Then reduce walk time. Eventually continuous jog.
regression: Increase walk time (2 min jog, 3 min walk). Reduce total session time.

name: 2 km Continuous Timed
objective: Measure and develop aerobic capacity over a fixed distance. Benchmark for off-season base.
work_description: 2 km continuous run at steady effort. RPE 5-6.
progression: Reduce time by 5-10s per month. Progress to 3 km at same pace.
regression: Reduce to 1 km. Or 1.5 km at easier pace.

name: 12-Minute Run (Cooper Test)
objective: Measure VO2 max estimate. Used as periodic benchmark (every 4-8 weeks).
work_description: Cover maximum distance in 12 min at steady pace. RPE 8-9 (maximal sustainable effort).
progression: Increase distance covered by 50-100m between testing blocks.
regression: Reduce to 8 min or 6 min if not ready for 12 min maximal effort.

name: 15-Minute Tempo Walk
objective: Low-impact aerobic foundation. Entry-level conditioning for return-to-sport or deconditioned athletes.
work_description: Brisk walking at 6-7 km/h. RPE 2-3.
progression: Increase duration by 5 min every 2 weeks. Progress to jog segments.
regression: Reduce to 10 min. Reduce pace.

name: 2 km Run Assessment
objective: Time-trial benchmark for aerobic capacity. Standardised assessment for field sport athletes.
work_description: 2 km run at maximal sustainable pace. RPE 8-9.
progression: Improve time by 5-10s per testing block (every 4-8 weeks).
regression: Reduce to 1.5 km. Allow walking if needed.

name: 30-Minute Zone 2 Bike
objective: Low-impact aerobic capacity. Alternative for athletes needing lower body impact reduction.
work_description: Cycling at 60-70% HRmax. Self-selected RPM (80-100). RPE 3-4.
progression: Increase duration to 40-45 min. Maintain HR zone.
regression: Reduce to 20 min. Reduce resistance.

name: Fartlek — Speed Play
objective: Aerobic capacity with unstructured intensity variation. Builds ability to change pace.
work_description: Continuous run with spontaneous surges (20-60s at moderate-fast pace) every 2-3 min. RPE varies 4-7.
progression: Increase surge duration. Decrease recovery between surges.
regression: Reduce total duration. Walk during recoveries instead of jog.

name: 20-Minute Aerobic Base
objective: Short-duration aerobic capacity. For days when time is limited but aerobic stimulus is needed.
work_description: Continuous run at 65-75% HRmax. RPE 4.
progression: Extend to 25 min. Maintain HR zone.
regression: Reduce to 15 min. Use jog-walk intervals if needed.

name: MAS 60m Standard
objective: Develop maximal aerobic speed. Run at individual MAS pace. A BCCI and ASCA standard protocol.
work_description: 60m in target time (determined by MAS test: distance covered in 60s all-out = MAS pace per 60m). Typically 8-10s per 60m.
sets: 6 reps × 3 sets. 5 min rest between sets.
progression: Reduce rest (27s → 25s → 20s). Increase reps per set (6 → 8). Decrease set rest (5 → 4 min).
regression: Increase rest (27s → 35s). Reduce reps (6 → 4 per set). Reduce sets (3 → 2). Reduce distance (60m → 50m).

name: Treadmill Threshold Intervals
objective: Develop aerobic power at lactate threshold using controlled treadmill pace.
work_description: 400m at 15-16 km/h (or individual threshold pace). RPE 6-7.
sets: 6-8 reps in 2-3 sets. 3-4 min rest between sets.
progression: Increase pace by 0.5 km/h every 2 weeks. Increase reps (6 → 8 per set). Decrease rest (60s → 45s).
regression: Reduce pace to comfortable conversational pace. Reduce reps to 4 per set.

name: 1 km Repeats
objective: Develop sustained aerobic power. Shorter rest builds lactate clearance.
work_description: 1 km at 75-85% effort. Target time e.g., 3:40. RPE 7.
progression: Increase reps (3 → 5). Decrease rest (4 → 3 min). Increase pace (3:40 → 3:30 per km).
regression: Reduce distance to 800m. Increase rest to 5 min. Reduce reps to 2-3.

name: 800m Repeats
objective: Develop aerobic power at higher intensity than 1 km repeats. Bridge between aerobic power and intensive tempo.
work_description: 800m at 80-90% effort. Target time e.g., 3:00-3:15. RPE 7-8.
progression: Increase reps (3 → 5). Decrease rest (5 → 3 min). Increase pace by 5s per 400m.
regression: Reduce to 600m. Increase rest to 5-6 min. Reduce reps to 2-3.

name: 400m Threshold Cruise
objective: High-volume aerobic power with multiple shorter reps. Develop pace judgment and lactate clearance.
work_description: 400m at 75-80% effort. Target time e.g., 75-80s. Avg speed ~19.5 km/h.
progression: Increase reps (5 → 8). Decrease rest (90s → 60s). Increase pace (80s → 75s per 400m).
regression: Reduce to 300m. Increase rest to 2 min. Reduce reps to 4.

name: 20m MAS Shuttle
objective: Develop MAS with directional change. Court and field sport specific.
work_description: 20m shuttles at MAS pace (determined by 20m MAS test or adapted from 60m MAS). Typically 4-5s per shuttle.
sets: 6-10 reps × 3 sets. 3-4 min rest between sets.
progression: Reduce rest. Increase reps per set. Add directional variation (side shuffle, backpedal).
regression: Increase rest. Reduce distance to 10m. Reduce reps and sets.

name: 30-15 IFT (Intermittent Fitness Test)
objective: Develop intermittent aerobic power. Shuttle-based, increasing speed. Court sport specific.
work_description: 30s shuttle runs at progressively increasing speed (determined by 30-15 IFT test result). 20-40m shuttles.
sets: Until fatigue (pre-determined number or until can't maintain pace)
progression: Run at higher velocity (VIFT) for training sets. Increase number of reps.
regression: Use shorter shuttle distance (20m). Reduce target speed by 1-2 km/h.

name: Yo-Yo IR1 Shuttles
objective: Develop intermittent aerobic power with standardized protocol. Widely used across field sports for pre-season conditioning.
work_description: 2 × 20m shuttles at progressively increasing speed. Beep dictates pace.
rest: 10s active recovery (2 × 5m jog) between each shuttle pair
progression: Train at 1-2 levels below max. Increase duration.
regression: Reduce shuttle distance (2 × 15m). Use fixed pace (not progressive).

name: 3 km Time Trial
objective: Benchmark for aerobic power and pace judgment. Longer than 2 km but sustainable at threshold.
work_description: 3 km run at maximal sustainable pace. RPE 8-9.
progression: Improve time by 10-15s per testing block.
regression: Reduce to 2 km.

name: 1 km Cruise — Tempo Pace
objective: Aerobic power at sustained threshold pace. Develops ability to hold race pace for extended duration.
work_description: 1 km at lactate threshold pace (82-87% HRmax). RPE 6-7.
progression: Decrease rest (2 min → 90s). Increase reps (4 → 6). Increase pace.
regression: Reduce to 800m. Increase rest to 3 min.

name: 5 × 3 min — Threshold Set
objective: Aerobic power at threshold with fixed work duration. Time-based, distance-agnostic.
work_description: 3 min at threshold pace (RPE 7, 85-90% HRmax).
progression: Decrease rest (2 min → 90s). Increase work (3 min → 4 min).
regression: Decrease work (3 min → 2 min). Increase rest (2 min → 3 min).

name: 20m MAS Shuttle — Beginner Entry
objective: Introduce maximal aerobic speed via shorter shuttle distance. Builds aerobic power foundation for young/low-training-age field athletes.
work_description: 20m shuttle at beginner MAS pace (determined by 200m time-trial or estimated as 70-75% of max 20m sprint). Target: 5-6s per shuttle.
rest: 30s passive rest (walk back to start). 3-4 min between sets.
progression: Reduce rest (30s → 25s → 20s). Increase reps per set (5 → 6 → 8). Reduce set rest (4 → 3 min). Progress to AP-001 (60m MAS).
regression: Reduce to 15m shuttle. Increase rest to 40s. Reduce to 1 set.

name: 60m Tempo — BCCI Standard
objective: Develop extensive tempo capacity. Sub-maximal speed with short recovery. BCCI pre-season standard.
work_description: 60m at 70-80% max speed. Finish in 10-12s. RPE 5-6.
sets: 10 reps × 2 sets. 3-4 min rest between sets.
progression: Reduce rest (30s → 20s). Increase reps per set (10 → 12). Decrease set rest (3 → 2 min).
regression: Increase rest (30s → 45s). Reduce reps (10 → 8 per set). Reduce sets to 1.

name: 100m Tempo
objective: Extensive tempo over longer distance. Speed maintenance at sub-maximal effort.
work_description: 100m at 70-80% max speed. RPE 5-6.
sets: 8-12 reps × 1-2 sets. 3-4 min rest between sets.
progression: Increase reps (8 → 12). Add second set. Reduce rest (walk back → 30s).
regression: Increase rest to 90s. Reduce reps to 6. Reduce to 1 set.

name: 80m Tempo — Timed Intervals
objective: Tempo running with fixed time-based start. Develop ability to recover between efforts on a clock. Cricket/field sport standard.
work_description: 80m run at sub-maximal pace (70-80%).
rest: Start every 40th second (time-based interval). Rest depends on work speed.
sets: 3 sets × 8 reps. 4 min rest between sets.
progression: Reduce start interval (40s → 35s). Increase reps per set (8 → 10). Increase distance (80 → 100m).
regression: Increase start interval (40s → 50s). Reduce reps (8 → 6 per set). Reduce to 2 sets.

name: 70m Run / 30m Walk Continuous
objective: Extensive tempo in continuous format. Run-walk pattern maintains steady moderate intensity.
work_description: 70m run at 65-75% max speed. RPE 4-5.
progression: Increase run segment (70m → 90m). Decrease walk segment (30m → 20m). Increase pace.
regression: Decrease run segment (70m → 50m). Increase walk segment (30m → 40m).

name: 6 × 100m Build-up
objective: Extensive tempo with acceleration patterning. Each rep builds speed progressively.
work_description: 100m starting at 50% speed, building 10% per 20m. Finish at ~100% in final 20m.
progression: Increase reps (6 → 8). Add second set.
regression: Reduce to 80m. Hold lower top speed (80% max). Reduce reps to 4.

name: Cricket Ground Circuit
objective: Extensive tempo using cricket ground perimeter. Builds sport-specific aerobic base. BCCI/ECB standard.
work_description: 12 rounds of a cricket ground (~400-450m per round) in 20 min. Target time: 1:35-1:45 per round. RPE 5-6.
progression: Reduce total time (20 min → 18 min for same rounds). Increase rounds (12 → 14).
regression: Reduce rounds (12 → 8-10). Walk recovery between rounds.

name: 2-4-6 Ladder
objective: Extensive/intensive tempo with escalating volumes. Builds both capacity and tolerance. Cricket standard.
work_description: Level 1: 2 runs within 6s total. 15s rest. Level 2: 4 runs within 13s total. 30s rest. Level 3: 6 runs within 21s total.
total_volume: 12 runs per set × 4 sets = 48 runs. Distance per run = 15-20m. Total ~720-960m.
progression: Reduce target times. Increase runs per level. Reduce set rest (2 min → 90s).
regression: Increase target times. Reduce to 2-4 ladder (omit 6). Reduce to 3 sets.

name: 50m Sprint × 8 — Tempo
objective: Short tempo at slightly higher intensity. Builds speed endurance base.
work_description: 50m at medium-high intensity (~80%). Finish in ~8-10s.
progression: Increase reps (8 → 12). Add second set.
regression: Reduce intensity to 70%. Reduce reps to 6. Increase rest to 90s.

name: Grass Sprints — 40m Tempo
objective: Low-impact tempo on grass. Reduced joint stress while developing tempo capacity. Rugby/Soccer standard.
work_description: 40m at 70-80% on grass. Barefoot or flat shoes optional. RPE 5.
sets: 12-15 reps × 1-2 sets. 3 min rest between sets.
progression: Increase reps. Add second set.
regression: Reduce to 30m. Increase walk-back time.

name: 30m Tempo — Short and Quick
objective: Very short tempo. Quicker turnover at moderate intensity. Develops rhythm.
work_description: 30m at 75-80% speed. Finish in 5-6s.
progression: Increase reps. Decrease walk-back time.
regression: Reduce to 20m. Increase rest.

name: 400m Repeats — Pre-Season Classic
objective: Develop intensive tempo capacity. Build speed endurance at moderate-high intensity. Classic pre-season protocol across all field sports.
work_description: 400m at 80-87% max effort. Target: 70-80s per 400m. RPE 7-8.
progression: Increase reps (5 → 7). Decrease rest (4 → 3 min). Increase pace (75s → 68s per 400m).
regression: Reduce to 300m. Increase rest to 5-6 min. Reduce to 3 reps.

name: Descending Ladder — 800-400-200-100
objective: Intensive tempo with increasing intensity as distance decreases. Builds speed endurance across multiple paces.
rest: Between reps: decreasing (4 → 3 → 2 min). Between sets: 6-8 min.
progression: Add second set. Decrease rest between reps. Increase pace on each segment.
regression: Omit the 800m (start at 400m). Increase all rest times by 1 min. Single set only.

name: 200m Repeats
objective: Intensive tempo at higher speed. Develop speed endurance at 85-90% effort.
work_description: 200m at 85-90% max speed. Target: 30-35s per 200m. RPE 8.
progression: Increase reps (6 → 10). Decrease rest (3 → 2 min). Increase pace (35s → 30s per 200m).
regression: Reduce to 150m. Increase rest to 4 min. Reduce to 4 reps.

name: 300m Repeats
objective: Intensive tempo bridging 200m and 400m pace. Develop feel for middle-distance pacing.
work_description: 300m at 82-88% max speed. Target: 48-55s per 300m. RPE 7-8.
progression: Increase reps (4 → 6). Decrease rest (4 → 3 min). Increase pace.
regression: Reduce to 250m. Increase rest to 5 min. Reduce to 3 reps.

name: 600m Repeats
objective: Longer intensive tempo. Develop aerobic power overlap with lactate threshold.
work_description: 600m at 80-85% max effort. Target: 2:10-2:30 per 600m. RPE 7-8.
progression: Increase reps (3 → 5). Decrease rest (5 → 4 min). Increase pace.
regression: Reduce to 500m. Increase rest to 6 min. Reduce to 2 reps.

name: 500m Repeats
objective: Bridge between 400m and 600m intensive tempo. Develop pace judgment at intermediate distance.
work_description: 500m at 82-87% max effort. Target: 1:40-2:00 per 500m. RPE 7-8.
progression: Increase reps. Decrease rest. Increase pace by 2-3s per 500m.
regression: Reduce to 400m. Increase rest to 5 min.

name: Pyramid — Build and Descend
objective: Intensive tempo across multiple distances within one session. Develop pace awareness and versatility.
work_description: 100m → 200m → 400m → 600m → 400m → 200m → 100m. Each rep at 80-90% of best effort for that distance.
rest: 2 min between shorter reps (100-200m). 4 min between longer reps (400-600m).
sets: 1 pyramid = 7 reps. 1-2 sets with 8-10 min rest between sets.
progression: Decrease rest between all reps. Add second set.
regression: Omit 600m (100-200-400-200-100). Increase all rest times.

name: Negative Split 800s
objective: Intensive tempo with pacing strategy. First half slower than second half — develops finishing speed.
work_description: 800m: first 400m at 75%, second 400m at 85-90%. Target overall: 2:40-3:00.
progression: Tighten the negative split margin. Decrease rest.
regression: Reduce to 600m negative split. Increase rest.

name: 30m Every 30s — Basic RSA
objective: Develop repeated sprint ability. Fixed time-based starts build ability to recover and reproduce maximal effort. BCCI standard.
work_description: 30m maximal sprint.
rest: Start every 30s. Rest = 30s minus sprint time (~25-26s passive rest).
progression: Reduce start interval (30s → 25s). Increase duration (5 → 10 min = 20 reps). Increase sprint distance (30 → 40m).
regression: Increase start interval (30s → 40s). Reduce duration to 3 min. Reduce to 70% intensity.

name: 30m Every 20s — Fatigue Maintenance
objective: Power maintenance under increasing fatigue. Shorter recovery than standard RSA. Tests ability to maintain speed with incomplete recovery.
work_description: 30m maximal sprint.
rest: Start every 20s. Rest = 20s minus sprint time (~15-16s).
progression: Increase reps (6 → 10). Reduce interval (20s → 18s). Increase distance (30 → 40m).
regression: Increase interval (20s → 25s). Reduce reps to 4. Reduce intensity to 90%.

name: 40m RSA — Field Sport
objective: Develop RSA over longer sprint distance. More specific to field sports with longer high-speed runs.
work_description: 40m maximal sprint.
progression: Reduce rest (60s → 45s). Increase reps (6 → 10). Add second set with 4 min rest between sets.
regression: Increase rest (60s → 90s). Reduce to 30m. Reduce reps to 5.

name: RSA Cluster — 3x30m
objective: High-density RSA. Cluster format allows more work in less time with intra-cluster incomplete recovery.
work_description: 3 × 30m maximal sprints per cluster. Intra-cluster rest: 20s between sprints.
progression: Increase clusters (3 → 5). Reduce intra-cluster rest (20s → 15s). Reduce inter-cluster rest (4 → 3 min).
regression: Reduce to 2 sprints per cluster. Increase inter-cluster rest to 5 min. Reduce to 2 clusters.

name: 20m Shuttle RSA
objective: Develop RSA with directional change. Court and field sport specific repeated sprint ability.
work_description: 20m sprint, touch line, 20m sprint back (40m total per rep with change of direction).
progression: Reduce rest (60s → 45s). Add second set. Increase reps.
regression: Single 20m (no return). Increase rest to 90s. Reduce reps to 4.

name: 25m × 6 — Tight Rest
objective: Short RSA with very tight rest. Develop ability to reproduce short explosive efforts under fatigue.
work_description: 25m sprint in 4-5s.
rest: 15s passive rest between reps. 3-4 min between sets.
progression: Reduce rest (15s → 12s). Increase reps per set (6 → 8). Increase sets (2 → 3).
regression: Increase rest (15s → 20s). Reduce reps (6 → 4). Reduce to 1 set.

name: 20m × 6 — 30s On, 60s Off
objective: Time-based shuttle RSA. Work window is fixed, making this a pacing challenge.
work_description: Complete minimum 11 runs of 20m in 60s. More runs = better performance. Target: 11+ runs per set.
progression: Increase target runs per set (11 → 13 → 15). Reduce set rest (60s → 45s). Add fourth set.
regression: Reduce target (<11 runs per set). Increase set rest (60s → 90s). Reduce to 2 sets.

name: Agility 4×10m Shuttle Continuous
objective: Short RSA with multiple directional changes. Develop COD speed under fatigue.
work_description: 4 × 10m shuttles continuous (40m total per rep). Target: minimum 21s per rep.
progression: Reduce target time per rep. Decrease rest. Increase reps.
regression: Reduce to 2 × 10m shuttle. Increase rest to 2 min. Reduce reps to 4.

name: 10m Shuttle RSA — Court Sport
objective: Court-specific RSA with multiple short-direction changes. Simulates badminton/tennis rally demands.
work_description: 5 × 10m shuttles (touch and go, 5 direction changes). One rep = ~50m total distance.
sets: 6-8 reps × 2-3 sets. 3-4 min rest between sets.
progression: Increase shuttles per rep (5 → 7). Decrease rest.
regression: Reduce shuttles per rep (5 → 3). Increase rest.

name: German Volume RSA
objective: High-volume RSA. Develop repeated sprint work capacity with controlled rest.
work_description: 30m sprint × 10 reps per set.
progression: Increase sets (3 → 4). Decrease inter-set rest.
regression: Reduce reps per set (10 → 6). Increase rest.

name: Direction Change RSA
objective: RSA with integrated directional changes. Sport-specific repeated agility.
work_description: 20m sprint → 90° cut → 10m sprint → 90° cut → 10m sprint. One rep = various path total ~40m.
progression: Increase cut angle (90° → 135° → 180°). Decrease rest.
regression: Reduce cuts. Flatten the path. Increase rest.

name: 20m RSA — Generous Rest
objective: Introduce repeated sprint ability with longer recovery. Designed for young/low-training-age field athletes building RSA foundation.
work_description: 20m maximal sprint.
rest: Start every 40th second. Rest = 40s minus sprint time (~37-38s).
progression: Reduce start interval (40s → 35s → 30s). Increase reps (6 → 10). Increase sprint distance (20m → 30m). Progress to RSA-001.
regression: Increase start interval (40s → 50s). Reduce to 4 reps. Reduce intensity to 80%.

name: 150m Repeats
objective: Develop speed endurance at near-maximal speed. Improve ability to maintain velocity beyond 100m.
work_description: 150m at 90-95% max speed. RPE 9.
progression: Increase reps (4 → 6). Decrease rest (5 → 4 min). Increase pace by 1-2s per 150m.
regression: Reduce to 120m. Increase rest to 6-7 min. Reduce to 3 reps.

name: Flying 30s — Speed Maintenance
objective: Maintain max velocity over 30m from a flying start. Develop the ability to hold top speed.
work_description: 30m timed max velocity with 30-40m build-up. Full recovery.
progression: Increase timed distance (30 → 40 → 50m). Decrease rest (5 → 4 min). Increase reps.
regression: Reduce to 20m timed. Increase rest to 6 min. Reduce to 3 reps.

name: Cut-downs — 150m
objective: Speed endurance with pace progression. Develop the ability to finish fast under fatigue.
work_description: 150m: first 50m at 70%, middle 50m at 85%, final 50m at 100%.
progression: Increase reps. Decrease rest. Increase each segment's speed by 2-3%.
regression: Reduce to 100m cut-down (50m build, 50m max). Increase rest.

name: Sprint Float Sprint — 100m
objective: Speed endurance with active recovery between efforts. Develop ability to recover and re-accelerate. Track athlete standard.
work_description: 100m sprint → 100m float (70%) → 100m sprint. 1 set = 300m.
rest: Walk-back recovery between 100m segments (~60s walk). 4-5 min full rest between sets.
progression: Increase sets (3 → 5). Decrease float recovery (walk → light jog).
regression: Reduce to sprint-float-sprint but only 80m each. Reduce to 2 sets.

name: 50m × 8 + 25m × 6 Combo
objective: Speed endurance combo. Longer efforts for base, shorter for intensity. Field sport standard.
work_description: Block 1: 50m sprint × 8 at 85-90%. Walk-back rest. Block 2: 25m sprint × 6 at 95-100%. Walk-back rest.
rest: Walk-back between reps. 4 min rest between blocks.
progression: Add second round of each block. Reduce walk-back speed.
regression: Reduce reps (50m: 8→6, 25m: 6→4). Increase walk-back time.

name: 100m × 6 — Timed
objective: Speed endurance over 100m with controlled rest. Benchmark for acceleration and speed maintenance.
work_description: 100m at 90-100% (depending on phase). Fresh: 95-100%. Pre-season: 80-90%.
progression: Decrease rest (3 → 2 min). Increase intensity (80% → 90% → 95%).
regression: Reduce to 80m. Increase rest to 4 min. Reduce to 4 reps.

name: Acceleration Build-up 60m
objective: Speed endurance with acceleration patterning through full 60m. Develops ability to hold top speed at distance.
work_description: 60m: build from 50% at 0m to 95% at 60m. Smooth acceleration across the full distance.
progression: Start at higher initial speed. Increase rep count.
regression: Reduce to 40m. Start at 60%.

name: 120m Repeats
objective: Speed endurance bridging 100m and 150m. Develop ability to hold speed beyond 100m.
work_description: 120m at 90-95% max speed. RPE 8-9.
progression: Increase reps. Decrease rest at same quality.
regression: Reduce to 100m. Increase rest to 6 min.

name: 80m Flying Start — Speed Maintenance
objective: Speed endurance from a rolling start. Emphasises max velocity maintenance.
work_description: 30m build-up to max speed, then 80m at max velocity maintenance. Total run = 110m.
progression: Extend timed segment (80m → 100m). Decrease rest if quality maintained.
regression: Reduce build-up (30m → 20m). Reduce timed segment (80m → 60m).

name: 10m Acceleration
objective: Develop first-step quickness and acceleration from a stationary start.
work_description: 10m maximal acceleration from 2-point or 3-point start.
progression: Increase rest to maintain quality. Add resisted sprint (sled). Progress to 20m.
regression: Reduce to standing start. Increase rest to 2 min.

name: 20m Sprints
objective: Develop acceleration phase (0-20m). The most common speed distance across field sports.
work_description: 20m maximal sprint.
progression: Add rolling start. Add resisted sprint. Reduce rest to 90s if maintaining quality.
regression: Reduce to 15m. Increase rest to 3 min. Reduce reps to 4.

name: 30m Sprints — Full Recovery
objective: Develop acceleration to top speed. 30m covers most field sport sprint distances.
work_description: 30m maximal sprint.
progression: Progress to flying 30m (build-up then timed). Add sled resistance.
regression: Reduce to 20m. Increase rest to 4 min. Reduce reps.

name: Flying 10m Timed
objective: Measure and develop max velocity. Flying start eliminates acceleration phase, isolates top speed.
work_description: 30-40m build-up to max speed, then 10m timed segment.
rest: 3-5 min passive rest (must be full recovery for max velocity)
progression: Extend timed zone (10m → 20m). Increase build-up distance for higher entry speed.
regression: Reduce timed zone to 5m. Use fewer reps. Increase rest.

name: Contrast Sprints — Resisted + Unresisted
objective: PAP-based speed development. Heavy resisted sprint potentiates subsequent unresisted sprint.
work_description: 10-15m resisted sprint (sled at 15-20% BW) → rest 30s → 20-30m unresisted max sprint.
rest: 30s between pair elements. 3-4 min between pairs.
progression: Increase sled load. Increase unresisted sprint distance.
regression: Remove sled (bodyweight only). Increase rest between pairs.

name: 40m × 4 — Speed
objective: Speed development at slightly longer distance. 40m is the max most field sports require at full speed.
work_description: 40m maximal sprint.
progression: Add rolling start. Add timing gates. Reduce to 2 min rest if quality maintained.
regression: Reduce to 30m. Increase rest to 4 min.

name: 15m Ball Start Sprints
objective: Develop acceleration from sport-specific reactive starts.
work_description: 15m sprint from reactive start (coach/partner signals with ball movement or call).
progression: Add directional change after sprint. Add decision element.
regression: Use standing start (no reactive element).

name: 3-Point to 10m Acceleration
objective: Develop initial acceleration mechanics from a 3-point stance. Track and field sport specific.
work_description: 10m from 3-point start. Maximal drive phase focus.
progression: Progress to 20m. Add resisted band.
regression: Use 2-point or standing start.

name: 400m Repeats — Hard
objective: Develop lactate tolerance. High-intensity 400m efforts with moderate rest. Builds ability to perform under high acidity.
work_description: 400m at 90-95% max effort. Target: 60-70s depending on ability. RPE 9-10.
progression: Increase reps (3 → 5). Decrease rest (5 → 4 min). Increase pace.
regression: Reduce to 350m. Increase rest to 6-7 min. Reduce to 2-3 reps.

name: 300m Repeats — Hard
objective: Lactate tolerance at higher speed than 400m. Intensity is higher, duration is shorter.
work_description: 300m at 95% max effort. Target: 40-50s. RPE 9-10.
progression: Increase reps. Decrease rest to 3 min.
regression: Reduce to 250m. Increase rest to 6 min. Reduce to 3 reps.

name: Broken 800m
objective: Lactate tolerance with pacing. Broken format teaches pace distribution under fatigue.
work_description: 800m broken as: 400m → rest 30s → 200m → rest 20s → 200m. Goal: hold same pace across all segments.
rest: 30s between 400m and 200m. 20s between 200m segments. 5-6 min between sets.
progression: Reduce segment rest. Add fourth segment. Reduce set rest.
regression: Reduce to broken 600m (300+300 or 400+200). Increase segment rest.

name: 200m Repeats — Hard
objective: Lactate tolerance at sprint speed. 200m at near-maximal speed with moderate rest.
work_description: 200m at 95% max effort. Target: 24-30s. RPE 9-10.
progression: Increase reps. Decrease rest to 2-3 min.
regression: Reduce to 150m. Increase rest to 5 min. Reduce to 3 reps.

name: Short-Long-Short
objective: Complex lactate tolerance. Paces through different intensities within a set.
work_description: 200m (fast) → rest 3 min → 400m (fast) → rest 4 min → 200m (fast). 1 set = 800m.
rest: 3-4 min between reps within set. 6-8 min between sets.
progression: Add fourth segment (100m). Decrease rest between segments.
regression: Reduce to short-short (200+200). Increase rest between all elements.

name: Treadmill Over-Unders
objective: Lactate tolerance with alternating high and low intensity. Develop recovery at pace.
work_description: 30s at 20 km/h → 30s at 6 km/h → repeat. RPE surges to 9-10 during high-speed segments.
rest: 30s at low speed (6 km/h) is active recovery between high-speed segments. 3-4 min rest between sets.
sets: 6 reps × 2-3 sets (each rep = 30s high + 30s low = 1 min)
progression: Increase high-speed pace (20 → 22 km/h). Decrease low-speed recovery (6 → 8 km/h). Increase reps per set.
regression: Reduce high-speed pace (20 → 18 km/h). Increase low-speed recovery (6 → 8 km/h walk). Reduce to 1 set.

name: 500m Repeats — Hard
objective: Lactate tolerance at 500m distance. Bridge between 400m and 800m capacity.
work_description: 500m at 90-95% max effort. Target: 1:20-1:35. RPE 9-10.
progression: Increase reps. Decrease rest.
regression: Reduce to 400m. Increase rest.

name: 250m Hill Repeats
objective: Lactate tolerance with hill resistance. Increased muscular demand potentiates lactate accumulation.
work_description: 250m uphill at 90-95% max effort. RPE 9-10.
progression: Increase reps. Find a steeper hill. Add weight vest.
regression: Reduce distance (200m). Use shallower hill. Increase walk-down time.

name: 60s On / 60s Off — Max Effort
objective: Lactate tolerance with maximal one-minute efforts. Develop ability to sustain high power output for extended duration.
work_description: 60s at maximal sustainable effort. Cover as much distance as possible. RPE 9-10.
progression: Increase rep count. Decrease rest (60s → 45s).
regression: Reduce to 45s work. Increase rest to 90s.

name: 30m Fatigue Power Test
objective: Assess and maintain sprint power under fatigue. Measure fatigue decrement across 6 reps. Cricket/field sport standard.
work_description: 30m maximal sprint.
rest: Start every 20th second. Approximately 15s rest per rep.
progression: Target <5% decrement from rep 1 to rep 6. Once achieved, reduce interval (20s → 18s).
regression: Increase interval (20s → 25s). Reduce reps to 4.

name: CMJ — Sprint Complex
objective: Maintain lower body power output. Jump quality before sprinting builds power-freshness.
work_description: 1 CMJ (maximal) immediately followed by 10m sprint (maximal). One complex = CMJ + sprint.
progression: Add med ball throw after sprint. Increase sprint distance to 20m.
regression: Remove CMJ (sprint only). Increase rest to 2 min.

name: Repeated Broad Jump
objective: Assess and develop lower body power maintenance. Distance decrement across reps indicates power fatigue.
work_description: 5 repeated broad jumps for maximum distance. Each jump immediately after landing from previous.
progression: Increase consecutive jumps (5 → 7). Target <10% distance decrement within each set.
regression: Reduce consecutive jumps (5 → 3). Increase rest between sets to 2 min.

name: Med Ball Power Endurance Complex
objective: Maintain upper body power output under fatigue. Complex format tests rotational and vertical power maintenance.
work_description: 3 throws per complex: overhead throw → chest pass → rotational throw (left and right = 1 pair).
rest: Minimal rest between throws within complex (5-10s). 2 min rest between complexes.
progression: Add fourth throw. Increase med ball weight. Reduce complex rest.
regression: Reduce to 2 throws per complex. Increase rest to 3 min. Reduce med ball weight.

name: Power Maintenance — In-Season Shorts
objective: Minimal dose power maintenance for in-season athletes. One exercise, low volume, full recovery.
work_description: 30m sprint OR 3 CMJs OR 3 med ball throws. Choose one modality per session. Maximal intent.
progression: Maintain quality. Do not progress — this is maintenance.
regression: Reduce to 3 reps. Reduce intensity to 90%.

name: 5-10-5 Shuttle Power
objective: Maintain COD power under minimal fatigue. Classic pro-agility shuttle as power maintenance.
work_description: Pro-agility shuttle: sprint 5m → touch → sprint 10m → touch → sprint 5m through finish. Maximal intent.
progression: Maintain time across reps (<3% decrement).
regression: Reduce to 3-6-3 shuttle. Increase rest.

name: Hurdle Hop Power Maintenance
objective: Maintain reactive strength and plyometric power with minimal volume.
work_description: 6-8 hurdle hops (two-footed, minimal ground contact). One rep = full set of hops.
progression: Maintain contact time and height across all reps.
regression: Reduce hurdle height. Reduce to 4 hurdles.

name: Light Power Touch — 10m Sprints
objective: Maintain acceleration power with minimal fatigue. Low-dose power maintenance for young athletes or match-week taper.
work_description: 10m maximal sprint from standing start.
progression: Increase to 15m. Add CMJ before sprint (progress to PM-002). Reduce rest if quality maintained.
regression: Reduce to 5m acceleration starts. Increase rest to 3 min. Reduce to 3 reps.

name: Active Recovery Jog
objective: Promote blood flow, reduce muscle soreness, maintain movement quality without adding fatigue.
work_description: Very light jogging at 50-60% HRmax. RPE 2-3.
progression: N/A — recovery is not progressed. Keep intensity low.
regression: Walk instead of jog. 10 min.

name: Recovery Walk
objective: Low-impact active recovery. Suitable for day after competition or high-volume training.
work_description: Brisk but comfortable walking. HR 50-60% max.
progression: N/A
regression: Reduce duration to 10 min. Stroll, not brisk.

name: Mobility Circuit
objective: Improve/maintain range of motion and movement quality. Low intensity.
work_description: Mobility sequence: hip 90/90 (2 min/side), couch stretch (2 min/side), thoracic rotations (1 min/side), shoulder CARs (1 min/arm), deep squat hold (2 min).
progression: Add duration in each position. Add more positions.
regression: Reduce hold times. Reduce number of positions.

name: Aqua Jogging
objective: Non-impact aerobic recovery. Suitable for high-impact athletes or lower-body injury return.
work_description: Deep water running with floatation belt. Upright running posture, arm drive with legs. RPE 3-4.
progression: Increase duration. Add high-knee intervals (30s fast, 60s easy).
regression: Reduce duration to 10 min. Shallow water walking instead.

name: Cycling Recovery
objective: Low-impact aerobic recovery with lower limb movement but no weight-bearing.
work_description: Low resistance, self-selected RPM (80-100). HR 50-60% max. RPE 2-3.
progression: N/A
regression: Reduce duration. No resistance.

name: Light Stretch Circuit
objective: Recovery through light stretching and mobility. Reduces muscle tension post-training or post-competition.
work_description: Full body light static stretching. 30s per stretch, 5s transition. Hamstring, quad, glute, chest, lats, hip flexor sequence.
progression: N/A
regression: Reduce to 5 min. Reduce to key stretches only.

name: Volleyball Block-Jump Conditioning
objective: Simulate volleyball blocking and attacking demands. Repeated vertical jumps with lateral movement at match intensity.
work_description: 3 × block jumps at net (maximal vertical) → lateral shuffle 3m → 1 approach jump (attack). One rep = 4 jumps + lateral shuffle.
rest: 30s walking recovery between reps. 3 min between sets.
total_volume: 24-32 jumps per set (48-64 total ground contacts)
progression: Increase jumps per block (3 → 5). Decrease rest (30s → 20s). Add third set.
regression: Reduce jumps per block (3 → 2). Remove approach jump. Increase rest to 45s.

name: Court Diagonal Recovery Shuttles
objective: Simulate court recovery and re-acceleration patterns from deep court positions. Tennis + badminton + volleyball defensive movement.
work_description: Start at net → drop step → sprint to deep corner → recover to centre → sprint to opposite deep corner. One rep = ~25m total.
rest: 45s passive rest between reps. 3-4 min between sets.
progression: Increase court distance. Decrease rest (45s → 30s). Add split-step at net before sprint.
regression: Reduce to single side (net → corner → net only). Increase rest to 60s.

name: Tennis Rally Intervals
objective: Simulate tennis rally demands. Multi-directional court coverage at match intensity.
work_description: 15s maximal court coverage (forward, lateral, diagonal) at rally intensity. Cover as much court as possible.
rest: 20s walking recovery between efforts. 3 min between sets.
total_volume: 4-6 min of high-intensity court work per set
progression: Increase work duration (15s → 20s). Decrease rest (20s → 15s). Add directional variability.
regression: Reduce work duration (15s → 10s). Increase rest (20s → 30s). Reduce sets to 1-2.

name: Badminton Rally Density
objective: Simulate badminton rally demands. Explosive multi-directional court coverage with short recovery.
work_description: 8s maximal multi-directional court coverage (lunges, jumps, directional changes).
rest: 15s walking recovery between efforts. 2-3 min between sets.
progression: Increase work duration (8s → 12s). Decrease rest (15s → 12s). Add more directional complexity.
regression: Reduce work duration (8s → 5s). Increase rest (15s → 20s). Reduce sets.

name: Lateral Shuffle Conditioning
objective: Develop lateral endurance for court sports. Repeated lateral shuffles at match intensity.
work_description: 10m lateral shuffle (both directions) at 70-80% intensity. Touch line, shuffle back.
rest: 30s passive rest between reps. 3 min between sets.
progression: Increase distance (10m → 15m). Decrease rest (30s → 20s). Add cross-over step variation.
regression: Reduce distance (10m → 7m). Increase rest (30s → 45s). Reduce to 1 set.

name: Diagonal Recovery + Re-accel
objective: Simulate court recovery and re-acceleration patterns. Match-specific directional conditioning.
work_description: 5m diagonal sprint → recover to centre → 5m diagonal sprint opposite direction. One rep = centre → diagonal → centre → opposite diagonal → centre.
rest: 30-45s passive rest between reps. 3-4 min between sets.
progression: Increase diagonal distance (5m → 8m). Decrease rest. Add split-step between diagonals.
regression: Reduce diagonal distance (5m → 3m). Increase rest to 60s.

name: Court Sport RSA — 5m Shuttle
objective: Court-specific repeated sprint ability with extremely short directional changes.
work_description: 5 × 5m shuttles (touch and go, 4 direction changes). One rep = 25m total distance.
rest: 45s passive rest between reps. 3 min between sets.
progression: Increase shuttles per rep (5 → 7). Decrease rest (45s → 30s). Increase sets.
regression: Reduce shuttles per rep (5 → 3). Increase rest to 60s.

name: Bike HIIT — 30s On / 30s Off
objective: High-intensity gym-based conditioning. Develop aerobic power and lactate tolerance on bike.
work_description: 30s maximal effort on bike (100+ RPM, high resistance). 30s easy spin (60-70 RPM, low resistance).
rest: 30s easy spin is active recovery between efforts. 3-4 min rest between sets.
total_volume: 5-7.5 min of maximal effort per set
progression: Increase reps per set. Decrease active recovery (30s → 20s). Increase resistance.
regression: Reduce intensity to 80%. Increase recovery to 45s. Reduce to 1 set.

name: Rower HIIT — 250m Repeats
objective: High-intensity rowing intervals. Full-body conditioning for gym-based sessions.
work_description: 250m maximal effort row (target 45-60s depending on ability).
progression: Reduce target split time. Decrease rest (60s → 45s). Increase reps.
regression: Reduce distance (250m → 200m). Increase rest to 90s. Reduce reps to 4-6.

name: KB/DB Circuit Conditioning
objective: Full-body gym conditioning using kettlebells and dumbbells. Develops work capacity without running.
work_description: 4 exercises: KB swings (40s), DB thrusters (40s), bent-over rows (40s), plank (40s). 20s transition between exercises.
rest: 20s transition between exercises. 2 min rest between rounds.
progression: Increase work duration (40s → 50s). Decrease transition (20s → 10s). Increase rounds.
regression: Reduce work duration (40s → 30s). Increase transition (20s → 30s). Reduce to 2 rounds. Lighter weights.

name: Cricket Bowling Spell Simulation
objective: Simulate the conditioning demands of a bowling spell. Intermittent high-intensity with walking recovery.
work_description: 1 spell = 6 overs. Each over: 30s high-intensity (run-up, bowl action, follow-through), 60s walking recovery. Repeat for 6 overs (18 min work).
rest: 60s walking recovery between overs. 5 min between spells.
progression: Reduce walk recovery (60s → 45s). Add second spell. Increase intensity of bowl simulation.
regression: Reduce overs per spell (6 → 4). Increase walk recovery (60s → 90s). Single spell only.

name: Light Bodyweight Circuit
objective: Low-fatigue conditioning that maintains movement quality without adding training stress.
work_description: Bodyweight circuit at 50% effort: air squats (30s), press-ups (30s), glute bridge (30s), bird-dog (30s). 15s transition.
rest: 15s transition between exercises. 2 min between rounds.
progression: N/A — recovery is not progressed. Keep intensity low.
regression: Reduce reps per exercise. Add 30s rest between exercises.

name: Pool Walk/Jog Intervals
objective: Non-impact active recovery. Suitable for post-competition or high-fatigue days.
work_description: 3 min light jog in shallow water → 2 min walking recovery. Repeat 3-4 cycles.
progression: N/A — recovery is not progressed. Keep intensity low.
regression: Walking only. Reduce duration to 10 min.
